# Support

## How to get help

| Need | Where |
|------|--------|
| Bug report | Open an issue on [symworx/symworx](https://github.com/symworx/symworx) using the bug template (when the repo is public) |
| Feature idea | Open an issue using the feature request template |
| Usage questions | Prefer issues on the monorepo so answers help others |
| Security concern | See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — do not file a public issue |

## Project

Open development is in the **[symworx](https://github.com/symworx/symworx)** monorepo (default branch **`develop`**): Rust crates, classical ML in `symworx-stats`, Python bindings, and the **`symview`** TUI (BioSym, StatsSym, LoadSym, SpatialSym).

> First public release is pending; the monorepo may remain private until then.

## Before asking

1. Read the repository `README.md` and crate-level docs under `crates/`.
2. Search closed and open issues for similar questions.
3. Include versions, OS, and minimal reproduction steps when something fails.

## Response expectations

This is open source software maintained as time allows. There is no guaranteed
SLA. Clear, minimal reproductions get the best results.
